title: The Submerged Continents of Atlantis and Lemuria (Cosmic Memory)
author: Rudolf Steiner
description: Rudolf Steiner presents an account of Atlantis, Lemuria and humanity's spiritual past through his concept of cosmic memory. The work belongs to Anthroposophical esotericism and records its claims about prehistory and the evolution of consciousness.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/ste-11_202012).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
